description: SASRec predicts the next item by applying causal self-attention to a user's interaction history. Learned item and position embeddings pass through attention and feed-forward blocks; the resulting features score candidate items by dot product. [Paper](https://arxiv.org/html/1808.09781v1)
motivation: Attention can select relevant recent actions while retaining access to longer histories, adapting to differing interaction densities. The supplied 'cold start' title describes a starting baseline; SASRec itself does not solve recommendation for completely unseen items or users without history. [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/1808.09781)
implementation_notes: Use RecHarness sasrec_perdataset with all four category routes. Preserve preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], and the environment default of 200 epochs. Select configurations using only the pinned macro validation HR@10. Keep artifacts within the trial directory and execution on one GPU. Architecture changes must update both the predictor writer and DiagnosisProbe compatibility. No benchmark results or improvements have been established here.
pseudocode:
For each category:
  Load the unchanged training split.
  Build padded histories, shifted positive targets, and sampled negatives.
  Encode histories with item/position embeddings and causal attention blocks.
  Minimize sampled binary cross-entropy on non-padding targets.
  Save model configuration and weights beneath the trial directory.
Write a predictor that restores the matching architecture and routes each category.
Use the host's macro validation HR@10 to compare trials.

originality.positive: Provides a well-defined sequential recommendation baseline.
originality.negative: Applying the published SASRec architecture to the matched task introduces little methodological novelty.

future_potential.positive: Sequence length, regularization, sampling, and loss choices provide concrete directions for validation-based search.
future_potential.negative: Benefits remain unmeasured; sparse histories and unseen item embeddings limit the baseline.

code_difficulty.positive: The supplied SASRec compatibility contract closely matches the baseline architecture.
code_difficulty.negative: Training, saved architecture, category routing, predictor generation, and diagnostic probes must remain consistent.
